# braintrust_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages a project-scoped MCP server connection in Braintrust.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "braintrust_project" "tools" {
  name = "agent-tools"
}

resource "braintrust_mcp_server" "tools" {
  project_id  = braintrust_project.tools.id
  name        = "Shared tools"
  url         = "https://tools.example.com/mcp"
  description = "Project tools exposed through MCP"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the MCP server, unique within the project.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier for the project that the MCP server belongs to.
- `url` (String) URL of the MCP server endpoint.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the MCP server.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of MCP server creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of MCP server deletion, or null if the MCP server is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the MCP server (UUID).
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the MCP server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the mcp server ID.
terraform import braintrust_mcp_server.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
